data: 354 real queries; 80 observed gold source domains; canonical 100-site descriptions
protocol: 20 deterministic random seeds. Pair distinct-source real queries into 177 two-facet composite queries per seed. Gold set is the pair of original source domains. Route budget B=5.
note: The pair construction is a controlled compositional stress test over real AgentWebBench queries; it is not an original benchmark task.
failed_balancing_attempts: global/sequential traffic-price penalties: Gini falls sharply but source recall collapses
hybrid evidence-first then balanced fill: no configuration simultaneously beat joint relevance in recall and Gini
conclusion: Marginal-evidence routing improves evidence/source coverage but amplifies site concentration. The current EviRoute formulation fails its intended joint quality/ecosystem gate.
